suggested_flex_slots.description: Equipment slots to change (e.g. boots, ring1). Empty if no changes suggested.

suggested_objectives.description: Stats to maximise in solver (e.g. ehp, thunder_defence). Empty if no changes suggested.

suggested_constraints.description: Hard minimum stat requirements the solver MUST satisfy. Use field names like min_hp, min_ehp, min_thunder_defence, min_earth_defence, min_water_defence, min_fire_defence, min_air_defence, min_mana_regen, min_walk_speed, min_hpr, min_life_steal, min_spell_damage_raw. Values are integers (except min_ehp which is a number). Only include constraints that matter for the fix.
